title: Sporothrix
extract:
Sporothrix is an  Infested Sniper Rifle that shoots explosive delayed  Viral barbs, while boasting very high damage, critical multiplier, and status chance, that is offset by its near nonexistent critical chance.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
One zoom mode that has 2.7x zoom distance and +50% headshot damage.
Shots explode in a 1.7 meter AoE radius after 0.9 seconds on impacting a surface or enemy.
Explosion deals innate  Viral damage.
Explosion delay reduces likelihood of inflicting self-stagger, but may allow enemies to move out of the explosion range if not directly hit by the projectile.
Initial hit and explosion apply status separately.
Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
Explosion does not affect combo counter.
Can use the Sporothrix-exclusive  Volatile Variant mod.
Can benefit from  Firestorm ( Primed) and  Cautious Shot.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Primary  Sniper Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Highest status chance of all sniper rifles, and second highest status chance of all weapons behind  Bubonico alt-fire.
Pinpoint accuracy while zoomed in; shots will hit exactly on the reticle dot, perfect for headshots.

Acquisition
The Sporothrix's blueprint and components can be acquired from Lvl 50-60 Isolation Vault Bounties (normal and Arcana). The blueprint and components can also be purchased from Loid after reaching Rank 3 - Clearance: Odima with  Necraloid, requiring  8,000 for the blueprint and  6,000 for each of the components.  The blueprint and all components can be traded.

Tips
Despite being a sniper rifle primarily intended against single targets, the exploding barbs make Sporothrix equally valuable as a crowd control weapon. Aiming at grouped enemies is a good way of maximizing the weapon's effectiveness.
Can equip the Volatile Variant augment mod which grants AOE damage.
There are several ways to make use of the Sporothrix's high critical damage by adding flat critical chance bonuses:
 Adarza Kavat  Cat's Eye periodically grants an additive 60% boost to critical chance.
 Smeeta Kavat's  Charm periodically grants a fixed 200% critical chance as one of its possible effects.
With another player using the  Mutalist Quanta's Alternate Fire, shooting through the orb adds a flat +25% critical chance, in addition to +25% critical damage and extra  Electricity.
 Harrow's  Covenant can add up to +50% additive crit chance, or +200% on headshots, after absorbing enough damage.
A fully ranked  Arcane Avenger has a 21% chance upon receiving damage to grant +45% flat critical chance.
 Mesa's  Ballistic Bullseye allows for a single bullet and subsequent explosion to gain an additive critical chance bonus, scaling with Ability Strength.
 Citrine's  Crystallize spawns a large crystal growth on enemies, shooting the growth inflicts a fixed 300% critical chance.
 Sevagoth's  Shadow Haze adds a flat +50% additive critical chance when attacking enemies inflicted with Reap or  Death's Harvest.

Trivia
This weapon shares its name with the real-world fungus genus Sporothrix. One particular species can cause Sporotrichosis in humans and animals, otherwise known as "Rose Gardener's Disease".
